cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(uuidv7_package_test LANGUAGES C)

# Found via the config generated by Conan's CMakeDeps from the recipe's
# package_info() — this is what a real end consumer of the package writes.
find_package(UUIDv7 REQUIRED)

add_executable(example example.c)
target_link_libraries(example UUIDv7::UUIDv7)

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME example COMMAND example)
